expectations: per-app sign-in page branding beyond the app name
context: constraint: linked accounts keyed on provider kind + subject
intent: Make Umbral the clear federated login for all apps, with optional per-app connector choice and several connectors per provider kind

decisions.decision: Store an app connector choice in two Umbral tables (app_connector_choices marker + app_connectors pairs with FK cascade to connectors)
decisions.why: Cascade gives FR-011; marker keeps an emptied app limited; queryable for FR-010
decisions.rejected: OpenIddict Properties JSON on the application

decisions.decision: Schema v2: ALTER TABLE connectors ADD COLUMN is_shared DEFAULT 1 when stored version is 1
decisions.why: Existing connectors become shared and apps all-shared with no data rewrite (FR-019)
decisions.rejected: A migration framework for Umbral tables

decisions.decision: Apps keep receiving the provider kind in idp; session gains a connector claim with the slug
decisions.why: README promises kind; a second connector of a kind would otherwise change idp for the same person
decisions.rejected: Send the slug in idp as the code does today

decisions.decision: Sign-in page reads client_id from the sanitized returnUrl authorize request
decisions.why: Page cannot name one app while returning to another
decisions.rejected: A separate client_id query value on /signin

decisions.decision: One pure offeredTo/strandedApps rule in Domains/Connectors.fs used by picker, authorize, admin warnings and Apps screen
decisions.why: Four callers would drift; current global count misses stranded limited apps
decisions.rejected: Each handler computing its own rule

decisions.decision: Connectors screen: one card per stored connector, empty card per kind with none, new POST /admin/connectors add form
decisions.why: Keeps the five-minute first-run path with no add step

decisions.decision: FR-018 validates chosen sets only against the document
decisions.why: Pure validation; document is due for removal
decisions.rejected: Also accept slugs that exist only in the database

decisions.decision: Every phase implemented by Sonnet workers run one at a time in the 003 worktree, docs in a separate worktree cherry-picked
decisions.why: User rule: coding goes to Sonnet, Opus reviews; parallel builds in one worktree would collide
decisions.rejected: Building Foundational inline as dispatch-briefs suggested

decisions.decision: OAuthRoundTrip.returnUrlOf reads the correlation cookie without consuming it
decisions.why: A provider decline fails before complete returns the correlation, and FR-001 needs the app after a failure
decisions.rejected: Losing the app context on access_denied

decisions.decision: Strand warnings name only apps the change newly strands; app-connectors-strand redirect carries the attempted choice
decisions.why: An app already offering nothing is not the change doing; the confirm button must post what was tried
decisions.rejected: Listing every app with nothing offered

decisions.decision: A connector card post without a displayName field keeps the stored display name and shared flag
decisions.why: Older scripted posts of the card form keep working and an absent checkbox is not read as not shared

decisions.decision: A slug equal to another kind name is refused when adding a connector
decisions.why: That path is where the empty card of that kind posts

plan.summary: Plan, research, data model and contracts for per-app connector choice, shared flag and several connectors per kind
plan.key_finding: The schema already allows several connectors per kind; only the Connectors screen limits it, and the session already carries the connector slug in idp

tasks.summary: 27 tasks: Setup 1, Foundational 9 (2 waves), US1 2, US2 10 (2 waves), US3 2, Polish 3; every file owned by one phase

implement.summary: 27/27 tasks: per-app connector choice, shared flag, several connectors per kind, sign-in page names the app, FR-008 session check, YAML keys, docs; 423/423 tests

approach: An app's connector choice lives in two Umbral tables and connectors gain is_shared (schema v2). One pure offeredTo rule drives the sign-in page (which reads the app from returnUrl), the FR-008 session check in authorize, and admin warnings. The Connectors screen shows one card per connector with an add form; the YAML document gets two optional keys; apps keep idp as the provider kind.
